### __OBTAINING DUPLICATE CHARACTERS__
When you obtain a character you already own, the duplicate copy will automatically be converted into Encounter Stones, Apatite Petals, and/or Talent Shards based on their rarity and how many times you've obtained them. Encounter Stones can be exchanged for various items in the Shop, while Talent Shards can be used to Ascend characters. Apatite Petals can be exchanged for select ★5 characters in the Shop.

Large Conquest: Concerted Onslaught has come online as of <t:1786849200>.
Large Conquest is a battle event where you fight against continuously appearing Kaiju.
Utilize stage effects, challenge the Kaiju, and clear quests to earn rewards and titles!

The quick clear feature is available for this event.
Stages up to Stage 04 will be unlocked and available as initial stages. By clearing any unlocked stage with ☆3, all its previous stages will also be considered cleared with ☆3.

## __ELIGIBILITY__
Reach Spec-Ops Rank 2 or higher.

## __EVENT DESCRIPTION__
- Large Conquest is a battle event where you fight against continuously appearing Kaiju.
- Access the event from Events > Large Conquest.
- Large Conquest does not require Stamina to challenge.
- Each quest requires you to form 2 squads. Some quests are of higher difficulty.
- A quest is cleared when a set number of rounds have elapsed or a set number of Kaiju have been neutralized.

- By completing ☆ Objectives and clearing quests, you can earn rewards like Dimensional Crystals, Proofs of Valor, Emblems of Defense, etc.
- You can exchange Proofs of Valor and Emblems of Defense for enhancement materials and other items in the Shop.

## __STAGE EFFECTS__
- Large Conquest features unique stage effects.
- Utilize the stage effects to give yourself an advantage in neutralizing Kaiju.

## __TITLES__
- In this Large Conquest, you can obtain separate titles after meeting the following conditions: "Obtain all Clear Rewards" and "Obtain the ☆18 Reward."

## __IMPORTANT__
- Once the event ends, Large Conquest rewards will no longer be available (and will not be sent to your Mail). Please remember to claim them within the event period.

## __OVERVIEW__
Total War has come online as of <t:1786503600>.
In Total War, you will challenge powerful enemies with up to 4 squads.
Muster your forces and complete quests to earn rewards!

### __AVAILABILITY PERIOD__
<t:1786503600> - <t:1787108399>

\**Rewards can be claimed until <t:1787713199>.*

## __ELIGIBILITY__
Reach Player Rank 3 or higher.

## __EVENT DESCRIPTION__
- Total War is an event where you take on a battle with up to 4 squads.
- When 5 rounds elapse or a squad is wiped out, the next squad takes over.
- The Boss Kaiju's remaining HP carries over when switching to the next squad.
- Rewards in Total War can be claimed up to 6 times per day. For quests you have already cleared, you can skip the battle to obtain rewards immediately.
- The reward claim limit is refreshed at the daily reset.¹

- Clear the Difficulty 6 quest to unlock Challenge Mode.
- In Challenge Mode, take on Kaiju with massive HP to compete for the top ranking.
- Challenge Mode has no daily limit on challenge attempts.
- In Challenge Mode, the Kaiju's remaining HP does not carry over between squads.
- In Challenge Mode, deployed characters cannot be added to another squad. However, the weapons they have equipped can still be equipped by characters in different squads.
- In Challenge Mode, individual squad setups and respective scores can be reset. Resetting a squad allows its deployed characters to be added to other squads. Your highest recorded total score in the ranking will be retained even after a reset.
¹ If you have remaining reward claims at 4:00 AM JST, they will be refreshed to reach a total of 6.

## __RANKING__
- Total War features damage-based ranking. You can earn rewards according to your rank.
- The total damage dealt in a battle serves as your score. Rankings will be determined based on the highest scores during the period.
- You can check your score and rank from Total War > Ranking.¹
- Ranking rewards will be distributed via Mail after the tallying period following the event's conclusion.
- For details on rewards, please refer to Total War > Ranking > Rewards.
¹ The Top 100 info on the Ranking screen is updated every 5 minutes. Depending on the timing of the update, your score may differ from the score displayed in the rankings.

## __MISSIONS__
- There are missions in Total War.
- For details about the missions, please head to Total War > Missions.

## __IMPORTANT__
- Reward claims will not be consumed even if you are defeated or retreat from battle.
- If you retreat, the damage dealt up to that point will not be saved as your score.
- If you clear a battle when the daily reset occurs during the session, it will count against your refreshed reward claim limits.
- Once the event ends, you can no longer start Total War battles. However, mission rewards can still be claimed until the end of the reward claim period.

- Data for a suspended battle started before the event ends will be kept for 12 hours from the start of the battle, regardless of whether the event concludes during the suspension. After 12 hours, the battle will be discarded, and any damage dealt up to that point will not be saved as a score.

- In Kaiju Rush, you will take on consecutive battles with a single squad while carrying over elements such as HP and SP from battle to battle.

- By achieving exclusive Kaiju Rush missions, you can earn various rewards.
- Kaiju Rush is divided into multiple areas, each with 4 difficulties. If you clear a higher difficulty with the maximum Rush Score, all quests on lower difficulties will automatically be considered cleared with a max score, with all the Designated Kaiju battles considered won.
- During the event period, the areas that can be challenged will unlock every two days.

## __STRATEGY CARDS__
- In Kaiju Rush, you can select one Strategy Card after each battle.
- The score indicated on a Strategy Card is added to your cumulative Rush Score upon selection.
- There are two types of Strategy Cards: cards with Buff/Recovery effects that give you an edge in the battles, and cards with Debuff effects that put you at a disadvantage.
- Cards with Buff/Recovery effects provide a smaller score increase, while cards with Debuff effects provide a larger score increase.
- Incapacitated characters cannot participate in the next battle. However, if you select a Strategy Card with an HP Recovery effect, they can rejoin the fight in the next battle.

## __ACCOUNT LINKING__
By linking your account, you can easily restore and transfer your game data even if you accidentally delete the app.
Additionally, if your current device malfunctions or if you wish to change devices, you can transfer your player data to the new device.

## __HOW TO LINK YOUR ACCOUNT__
You can link your account to your Apple Account or Google Account.
Steps to Link Account:
1. Select the global menu from the top right of the Home screen.
2. From the Menu (≡) on the top left of the screen, select Account Linking.
\**Account Linking is not possible via "Data Transfer" on the title screen.*

3. On the Confirm Link screen, you can choose to "Sign in with Apple" or "Sign in with Google."

## __FAQ: REGARDING ACCOUNT LINKING__
Q1: How do I restore my data or transfer my account?
A1: Access Title Menu (≡) on the title screen, select Data Transfer and follow the on-screen instructions.

Q2: After transferring account, will I be able to pick up my game progress from when I linked my account?
A2: You can proceed with the game from when you were last online. For example, if you link your account when a mission is ongoing and transfer your account after clearing the mission, the game will proceed from the time when the mission is cleared.

Q3: After transferring my account to a different device, can I still play on the original device?
A3: Yes, you can play on both devices. However, you cannot log in to the same account on both devices simultaneously. If a new login is detected on a device, you will be returned to the title screen on the previous device.

Q4: Will my linked account be unlinked if I delete my player data?
A4: No, deleting your player data will not unlink your account. To unlink an account, go to Menu (≡) > Account Linking.

Q5: I wish to change my linked account.
A5: To do so, first unlink your current account via Menu (≡) > Account Linking. You will then be able to link a new account.
